messages:
mike.dev: getting a bunch of 401s today from our lambda when calling Redwood - started after a deploy. response: {"error":{"type":"invalid_api_key","message":"API key invalid or expired"}}

lina.support: sorry — can you paste a minimal curl repro? are you hitting hosted or dedicated?

mike.dev: hosted (api.redwood.com). repro is:```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat``` response shows 401 and that error json. works fine from my laptop, fails from our staging env and prod (both behind our reverse proxy)

sam.oncall: intermittent vs 100%? any pattern (payload size, cookie, path)?

mike.dev: 100% from the proxy when user has lots of cookies (we store session+feature flags in cookies). if I curl from the proxy host but WITHOUT the long Cookie header it works. with long Cookie header -> 401.

lina.support: can you capture the raw request hitting our gateway (trace-id)? we can check whether the Authorization header made it through.

mike.dev: trace id 01H8Q2F2X. i attached a tcpdump snippet (trimmed). here's a quick test I ran from the proxy box that reproduces:```# emulating a huge cookie
curl -v -H "Cookie: session=abc; big="$(python3 -c 'print("x"*7000)')" -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC..." https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"x"}'
* Connected to api.redwood.com
> Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC...
> Cookie: session=abc; big=xxxx... (7000 chars)
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< content-type: application/json
< date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 12:03:45 GMT
< content-length: 99
{"error":{"type":"invalid_api_key","message":"API key invalid or expired"}}
```

devops.sre: from the tcpdump can you see the outgoing request to our egress? maybe our proxy is chunking/combining headers. what proxy are you using?

mike.dev: vendor is FastEdge v2.7. we saw them mention a header-length optimisation in their release notes.

sam.oncall: quick check — can you post the incoming request from client -> proxy vs proxy -> internet? If proxy drops or truncates Authorization it's on the proxy.

mike.dev: here's incoming from client to proxy (Authorization present), outgoing from proxy to internet (dumped headers): outgoing request has Cookie but Authorization header missing. so proxy is dropping it when total header size exceeds ~8192 bytes.

lina.support: confirmed on our side the trace shows no Authorization reaching api-redwood gateway for that trace id. gateway returns invalid_api_key because it treats request as unauthenticated.

edge-bot: deploy-bot: note: our gateway expects Authorization header or x-api-key. If missing -> 401 invalid_api_key.

devops.sre: two options: 1) short-term workaround: use X-Api-Key header (less likely to be stripped in some proxies) or reduce cookie size 2) vendor patch: ask FastEdge to stop dropping Authorization when header length > limit. can you test X-Api-Key?

mike.dev: tested X-Api-Key: works!```curl -H "X-Api-Key: sk_live_ABC..." -H "Cookie: session=abc; big=..." https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"hi"}'``` returns 200.

lina.support: good workaround. we'll flag this ticket for internal docs (note: proxies can drop auth when headers exceed size). we recommend using short-lived keys for browsers and keep auth on server-side.

sam.oncall: filed vendor ticket with FastEdge (TICKET-8792). they acknowledged bug: header merge behaviour regressed in v2.7. vendor ETA patch 24h.

mike.dev: thanks — we'll roll X-Api-Key in the short term and plan cookie compaction. can you confirm whether we should rotate the key after switching headers?

lina.support: rotating is optional but recommended if the key was shared in logs. if you switch header name only it's same secret so rotation reduces blast radius. if you want we can generate a new scoped key for embeddings-only and give you rotation steps. :thumbsup:

mike.dev: please generate an embeddings-only key and i'll swap it in prod. thanks everyone — huge help.

lina.support: created ephemeral key id rk_ey_01FG - scope: embeddings-only - added to ticket. closing once you confirm it's applied.

mike.dev: applied and prod is green. closing. :party:
